name: Decrypted Text
description: Inline text that scrambles into random glyphs and resolves letter by letter into the real text, triggered by hover, click, scroll into view, or both view and hover, with optional looping and cursor-radius scrambling.
contents: Single inline text span with per-character cells
Screen-reader-only copy of the full text and aria-hidden animated glyphs
behavior: Characters are replaced by random glyphs from a pool and revealed in a chosen order (start, end, center, random), either all at once over iterations or one at a time when sequential
Trigger is set by animateOn: hover, click, view, inViewHover
Click mode can play once or toggle between decrypted and encrypted
Loop re-encrypts and decrypts repeatedly after a delay and pauses while offscreen
With hoverRadius above 0, letters near the pointer re-scramble with a smooth falloff
Scrambled glyphs are scaled horizontally to fit the width of the original letter
Reduced motion preference skips the animation and shows the final state
editableByProps: Text, tick speed, number of iterations, sequential or simultaneous reveal and reveal direction
Scramble character set or reuse of the text's own letters
Trigger (hover, click, view, view plus hover), click mode, loop and loop delay
Scramble tint color and class names for revealed, scrambled and wrapper text

needsCodeEdit.change: Change fade brightness range of scrambled letters
Change flip animation angle or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: flipFrames function and the effect flip useIsomorphicLayoutEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the settle transition timing of revealed letters
Change when the view trigger fires
needsCodeEdit.where: IntersectionObserver threshold in the view useEffect

fixed: Requires motion (motion/react) and Tailwind CSS classes (sr-only, invisible, absolute, whitespace-pre-wrap)
Needs the 'use client' directive and runs only in the browser for measurement and observers
Minimum tick interval is 16ms, lower speed values are clamped
Words never break across lines (whitespace-nowrap per word)
Hover trigger needs a pointer, so touch devices only see it through click or view
Loop pauses while the element is offscreen
Text is not editable per character after mount, a changed text prop resets state

options.look: Hidden letters show random glyphs that swap each tick until they resolve to the real letter
options.useWhen: Hero headline or hacker-style tagline that should feel like code being decrypted

options.look: Scrambled glyphs are dimmed and brighten as they approach reveal, then settle to full opacity
options.useWhen: Subtle section heading or intro line that should emerge softly on scroll into view

options.look: Each glyph change and final reveal tilts in with a 3D rotateX flip
options.useWhen: Stats, labels or nav links where a mechanical split-flap feel suits hover or click
